title: Prove ad hoc review handoffs with typed handlers

intentCoverage.report:
### Dough Intent Coverage Report

- **Verdict:** **Caught.** `expect(doneStop).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` at `dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-branch-result-race.spec.ts:156` failed when a manual `markDone` superseded by a newer quiet completion proceeded into `finishNativeDone` and invoked `doneStop` on the observed loaded `"waiting"` Claude session path.
- **Next proof action:** None required for this promise on the observed superseded-manual-Done native-stop path.
- **Prior disposition / planned repair:** Matches no open gap or new repair decision. Plan `742` Slice 2 previously scratch-probed `doneTransition.ts` (`record.doneAt !== candidate.doneAt`, which failed earlier at the `storyReview` tree assertion on line `146`); queued sibling `SEED-413#restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews` (`.planning/slice-plans/743-restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews/PLAN.md`) covers Done-capture proof from plan `734` and does not target this race assertion.

#### Evidence

- **Story and revision:** `SEED-413#prove-ad-hoc-review-handoffs-with-typed-handlers` (`.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#prove-ad-hoc-review-handoffs-with-typed-handlers`, plan `.planning/slice-plans/742-prove-ad-hoc-review-handoffs/PLAN.md`) at `144fc9308f7f47b241e4ec36b07658046aea446e`.
- **Promise checked:** Scope & Key example 1 — *"Retain a native stop observer in the race"* and *"A manual Done has read an earlier commit and is held in ancestry validation. When a quiet completion captures a later commit and the manual mark resumes, Review changes shows the later tree, only the baseline and later revision stay pinned, and no native stop runs."* Validated the suggested `doneMarks.ts:171` target against `144fc9308f7f47b241e4ec36b07658046aea446e` and reused it directly because Slice 1 extracted `finishNativeDone.ts` from `doneMarks.ts` while Slice 2's earlier `doneTransition.ts` probe halted at line `146` before reaching line `156`.
- **Fault introduced:** In `dashboard/server/doneMarks.ts:171-172` (`markSessionDone`), replaced `if (marked?.doneAt !== doneAt) return marked ?? doneSessionRecord(record, doneAt);` with `if (marked === undefined) return doneSessionRecord(record, doneAt);` so a resumed manual Done whose `doneAt` (`minutesAgo(20)`) lost to a quiet completion (`minutesAgo(10)`) treats the returned `marked` record as its own mark and enters `finishNativeDone(..., { intent: "manual", ... })`.
- **Fixture and arrangement:** `aCheckoutWithWorktree("draft")` (`dashboard/backend-tests/support/doneCaptureCase.ts`), `makeMe.aLaunchRecord` (`sessionId: "isolated-draft"`), `makeMe.anAcceptedAttempt`, `makeMe.aCompletionSubmission`, and `NativeDoneMarks` configured with a `capture` callback holding `captureBranchResult` after reading `earlier` and a `doneStop` spy on the `"claude"` `DoneHost` over a `loaded("waiting")` session state.
- **Maintained check and catching assertion:** `dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-branch-result-race.spec.ts` (`"a newer quiet Done takes precedence over a manual mark still capturing its branch"`), caught by `expect(doneStop).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` at line `156` (claim bounded to this superseded manual `markDone` race path on a loaded waiting session).
- **Run and restoration observations:**
  - Isolated detached scratch worktree created at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-742-BQh7kN` (`144fc9308f7f47b241e4ec36b07658046aea446e`); pre-probe `git status --short` was empty (`?? node_modules` after symlinking `node_modules`).
  - Focused command: `caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:backend -- review/ad-hoc-branch-result-race.spec.ts`.
  - **Baseline:** Passed `1/1` on Vitest `v5.1.0` (`1,414 ms` test, `2.89 s` runner duration).
  - **Faulted (under `EXIT` restoration trap):** Failed `1/1` on Vitest `v5.1.0` (`915 ms` test, `1.44 s` runner duration). Reach and wrong behavior on the intended path were verified before line `156`: `expect(heldRevision).toBe(earlier)` (line `126`), `expect(reviewed).toMatchObject({ kind: "branch-result", baseline, tree: later })` (line `146`), and `sessionBranchPins` assertions (lines `152-155`) all passed first, confirming the manual `markDone` held on `earlier` and was superseded by the quiet report's `later` commit, after which `finishNativeDone.ts:89` wrongly called `doneStop` once with `[{ host: "claude", name: "Save the latest update", sessionId: "isolated-draft", shortId: "isolated" }, { path: ".../integration", shown: ".../integration" }, AbortSignal]`, failing line `156`.
  - **Restored & cleanup:** `dashboard/server/doneMarks.ts` restored (`git diff` empty, `git status --short` matching pre-probe state); rerun of the focused command passed `1/1` (`951 ms` test, `1.46 s` runner duration); symlink and untracked `test-results` removed, `git status --short` verified empty, `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-742-BQh7kN` removed via `git worktree remove`, and primary worktree verified clean.
